verdict.rationale: A runtime probe shows Phaser publishes an official examples index at phaser.io/llms.txt, with an API that returns example source code. That is first-party example material an AI-native user can explore programmatically. However, nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference, and nothing shows the examples can be run in place; the docs pages only show static code snippets. missing for 10: documented interactive API reference, evidence that examples are runnable/editable in-browser, linkage between API reference entries and examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: phaser.io/llms.txt is live as a programmatic examples-API index ('# Phaser Examples Index... For full metadata and source code, use the API: GET /api/v1/examples/{id}')
